holds.reason: Extracted text includes old safety labels, seating values, repeated E12 headers and placeholder photo text concealed by current design. Only visible rendered data is used. Visible E12 has no AEBS chip; do not borrow hidden text.
Downloaded URL revisions differ from visible footer: D7E URL C/footer D; C12E URL G/footer D; E12 URL G/footer D. July-2026 cover date retained; filename alone does not establish technical revision.

BRS8 2026 guide, February-2025 sales sheet and BRS5 November-2022 DRAFT are not merged. The current page says 422 kW LFP, 350 kW and 45 seats/20 standees; BRS8 gives 419 kWh and Voith drive but no linked exact capacity. Sales sheet also prints 150 L fuel, likely template error; do not infer hybrid or fuel tank.

Visible battery row says 85 months / 7.5 years / 800,000 km; prose says seven years and five months. 85 months and 7.5 years differ. Preserve conflict, no clean 7.5-year promise. 36-month chassis/body, motors and HV componentry are printed. Scope is TfNSW Panel 4, not every retail bus.
